description:
Perform a hierarchical multiple regression analysis on the open dataset 'ExamAnxiety.csv' to predict 'Exam' scores. 

1. Open a Linear Regression analysis.
2. In **Block 1**, enter 'Anxiety' as the covariate.
3. Create **Block 2** and enter 'Revise' as the covariate.
4. Ensure Model Fit statistics (R, R², Adjusted R²) and Model Comparisons (F test) are enabled.
5. Save the Jamovi project to '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/HierarchicalRegression.omv'.
6. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/hierarchical_regression_report.txt' with the following format (replace <value> with the actual number rounded to 4 decimal places):

Model1_R2=<value>
Model2_R2=<value>
R2_Change=<value>
R2_Change_Significant=<yes or no>
Revise_B=<value>
Anxiety_B_Model2=<value>
